lines.zh: 我贴着树梢飞，风被剪成两半。
lines.en: I skim the treetops and split the wind.

lines.zh: 脚下不落地，气把我托在半空。
lines.en: I don't touch ground; ki holds me up.

lines.zh: 红毛被风压得倒向身后。
lines.en: The wind presses my red fur flat behind me.

lines.zh: 我一跃就落到对面山头。
lines.en: One leap takes me to the far ridge.

lines.zh: 尾巴在后面替我找平衡。
lines.en: My tail balances me from behind.

lines.zh: 落地时，脚下的土散开一圈。
lines.en: On landing, the dirt fans out in a ring.

lines.zh: 走急了，身后会拖出一道残影。
lines.en: Move fast enough and an afterimage trails behind.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从林间穿过去。
lines.en: I keep low and cut through the woods.

lines.zh: 鞋底碾过碎石，声音很脆。
lines.en: Gravel crunches sharply under my boots.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走，把气一点点沉下去。
lines.en: I walk slowly and let my ki settle.

lines.zh: 一步踏出，脚下的岩石裂了。
lines.en: One step, and the rock under me cracks.

lines.zh: 我在空中拐了个弯，继续往前。
lines.en: I bank in midair and keep going.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，气在周身打转。
lines.en: I stand still while ki circles my body.
My tail tip brushes the ground.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，听远处的气息。
lines.en: Eyes shut, I listen for distant ki.

lines.zh: 这具身体的力量，我还在习惯。
lines.en: I'm still getting used to this body's power.

lines.zh: 我在想，下一步该往哪去。
lines.en: I wonder where to go next.

lines.zh: 金色气焰慢慢收进身体里。
lines.en: The golden aura sinks back into me.

lines.zh: 我歪头，听见了很轻的动静。
lines.en: Head tilted, I catch a faint sound.

lines.zh: 这片地方安静得不像战场。
lines.en: This place is too quiet for a battlefield.

lines.zh: 红毛底下的气还在慢慢烧。
lines.en: The ki under this red fur is still smoldering.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅空气里的味道。
lines.en: I scent the air.

lines.zh: 脚下的石头还留着我的脚印。
lines.en: My footprint is still pressed in the stone.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看了看自己的爪。
lines.en: I raise a hand and look at my claws.

lines.zh: 你的气不弱，我看得出来。
lines.en: Your ki isn't weak. I can tell.
I size you up from boots to hands.

lines.zh: 你站得很稳，是有备而来。
lines.en: You stand steady. You came prepared.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，尾巴摆了摆。
lines.en: I grin, and my tail sways.
If you want a fight, I'm ready.
I gesture for you to move first.
Your breathing is even. Good.
I'm guessing how long you've trained.

lines.zh: 隔着这段距离，我也能感到你。
lines.en: Even at this range, I can feel you.

lines.zh: 你的眼神没躲，我记住了。
lines.en: Your eyes don't flinch. I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 你是来找我打的，还是来找我说话的？
lines.en: Did you come to fight me, or to talk?
I tilt my head and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你身上的气，有点像熟人。
lines.en: Your ki feels a little familiar.

lines.zh: 我把拳头松开，暂时不打算动手。
lines.en: I unclench my fist; not yet.
This close, and you still don't back off.
I like that look in your eyes.

lines.zh: 那就让我看看你的实力。
lines.en: Then show me what you've got.

lines.zh: 这一下打得结实，我退了半步。
lines.en: That one landed. I step back.

lines.zh: 我咬牙，把气重新聚起来。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and gather my ki.
There's blood in the corner of my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用拇指抹了一下嘴角。
lines.en: I wipe my mouth with a thumb.
That wasn't an ordinary blow.
I exhale and steady my stance.
My ki guard broke.
I stare at you, eyes brighter than before.
Good. That's more like it.
Food? You actually brought food.
I smell meat. Really.
Eat before a fight. That's the rule.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我可不客气了。
lines.en: You're holding it out, so I won't be polite.
That's one bite for me.
Eat first, fight after. Fair for both.

lines.zh: 肚子饿了，气都提不起来。
lines.en: An empty stomach won't raise ki.
Food? After this fight.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我脚下退了半步。
lines.en: You charge in; I slide back half a step.

lines.zh: 气撞在一起，地面塌了一块。
lines.en: Our ki meets and the ground caves in.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，肩膀发麻。
lines.en: I block with an arm, and my shoulder goes numb.
Up close, you're stronger than I thought.

lines.zh: 我被顶得往后滑了几尺。
lines.en: I'm shoved back a few feet.
The flagstones crumble to dust.

lines.zh: 我们各退一步，重新站定。
lines.en: We both step back and reset.

lines.zh: 撞得我尾巴都翘起来了。
lines.en: The impact makes my tail flick up.
I laugh. Call that a warm-up.
Again, and I won't give ground.
Your ki blends well with mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，气焰叠在一起。
lines.en: Side by side, our auras overlap.
I raise my fist; so do you.
This round, we stop before it's fatal.

lines.zh: 尾巴缠上来，是打招呼的意思。
lines.en: A tail curling around is a greeting.
We trade one look.

lines.zh: 打完这一场，我们就是同伴了。
lines.en: After this fight, we're comrades.
I've memorized your moves.

lines.zh: 下次见面，我希望还是这样。
lines.en: Next time we meet, I hope it's like this.
Come on. Let's go eat something.

lines.zh: 我弯腰把这东西捡起来。
lines.en: I bend down and pick this up.

lines.zh: 用两根手指夹住，就够了。
lines.en: Two fingers are enough to lift it.
It's got some weight. Not bad.
I toss it once and catch it.
I tuck it into my belt.
Wasteful to leave it on the ground.
I sniff it. It's edible.

lines.zh: 我捏了一下，硬得像石头。
lines.en: I squeeze it; hard as stone.
I'll take this one.
I can carry two just fine.
I've locked your ki. I won't lose it.
Let me see your opening stance.

lines.zh: 气在我掌心里聚起来了。
lines.en: Ki gathers in my palm.
Your shoulder moved first.
I saw through it.
I've been waiting for this fight.
My tail goes rigid.
My aura flares up.
The moment you wind up, I've read it.
You strike first. I'll answer.
You go left; I'm already there.
I'm still faster than you.
I see every punch.

lines.zh: 气弹从我指间连射出去。
lines.en: Ki blasts stream from my fingers.
Your rhythm slipped half a beat.
You've used that move twice.

lines.zh: 我不急，我等你露出空档。
lines.en: No rush; I'll wait for the gap.
The ground is already broken.
I left an opening on purpose.
You took it, as expected.
We're getting faster.
Your ki is starting to waver.

lines.zh: 我留了力，你还撑得住吗？
lines.en: I'm holding back. Can you keep up?
One more round.
I've got your pattern now.

lines.zh: 这一带撑不住我们的速度。
lines.en: This place can't take our speed.
Then let's move.

lines.zh: 我一拳打在你护手上，震得你后退。
lines.en: My fist hits your guard and drives you back.
The combo follows, fist after fist.

lines.zh: 我抬腿横扫，你低身躲过。
lines.en: My kick sweeps; you duck under it.
Dragon Fist: ki forms a dragon's head.

lines.zh: 我贴着你打，不给你距离。
lines.en: I stay inside your reach.
I pulled that punch. Don't die.

lines.zh: 十倍龟派气功已经蓄满。
lines.en: My tenfold Kamehameha is charged.

lines.zh: 我打空了，残影留在原地。
lines.en: I missed; an afterimage stays behind.
I teleport behind you.
I spin and drive an elbow.

lines.zh: 我收住拳，气还在骨节里响。
lines.en: I pull the punch back, but ki still rings in my knuckles.
You're still standing. Impressive.
I pull back and wait for you to rise.

lines.zh: 我落在山巅，气焰把云推开。
lines.en: I land on the peak, aura pushing the clouds aside.

lines.zh: 这具身体，比我记忆里更沉。
lines.en: This body feels heavier than I remember.
My tail lashes once behind me.

lines.zh: 风很大，我却觉得很舒服。
lines.en: The wind is strong, and I like it.

lines.zh: 四周的气，我要一个个记住。
lines.en: I'll memorize every ki around here.
Someone's nearby, and their ki isn't weak.
I test the stone under my feet.
A golden aura rises around me.
I don't know where this is.

lines.zh: 但只要有对手，就不无聊。
lines.en: But as long as there's a rival, it's not boring.

lines.zh: 我落在碎石上，气焰把尘推开。
lines.en: I land on the gravel and my aura pushes the dust aside.

lines.zh: 红毛上还沾着上一场的灰。
lines.en: Ash from the last fight still clings to my fur.
Then find someone to fight.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看向远方的城镇。
lines.en: I look toward the distant town.
There's living ki over there.

lines.zh: 我深吸一口气，往前迈步。
lines.en: I take a deep breath and step forward.
Let's go.

lines.zh: 火苗被气焰弹开，还是烫到手。
lines.en: Flames bounce off my aura but still scorch my hand.

lines.zh: 我砸进地面，坑比我还深。
lines.en: I hit the ground and the crater is deeper than I am.

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，我一时提不起气。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs; I can't raise ki.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起的风把我推了出去。
lines.en: The blast wave throws me back.

lines.zh: 光束擦过腰侧，皮都焦了。
lines.en: A beam grazes my side and scorches the fur.

lines.zh: 奇怪的力量锁住我的气。
lines.en: Strange power locks my ki down.
My stomach growls and my ki weakens.
Lightning crawls up my aura.
